original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.export_ces_recovery_panel import export

out = export(agent='Axiom III',
             dir_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons',
             out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/dashboard/ces_recovery_axiom_iii.json')
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
